name: strict-rubric-in-prompt-ceiling
hypothesis: Pi-faithful-completion pattern: insert the strict rubric into the system prompt (no training) and measure whether the BASE model has headroom. If ceiling unlocks (+0.10+), distill onto base via SFT under normal prompt.
modified: task_scaffold.py with rubric-aware prompt prepended (strict_task_scaffold.py); restored after diag
verdict: no-ceiling — strict prompt slightly hurts (-0.18σ). Outcome up +0.015, BUT format_compliance -0.195 and cross_file_caller_recall -0.194. Strict rubric distracts model from format/structure.
key_insight: Unlike pi-faithful-completion (where strict prompt unlocked +0.169), code-comprehension does NOT have a prompted-ceiling gap. The base model already operates near its rubric ceiling on the composite axes that respond to prompt changes. Outcome can lift, but other sub-scores compensate downward.
implication: Prompted-ceiling distillation (the listed methodology) has limited upside here — the high-composite filtered examples will be few and similar to the base's current behavior. Recommend pivoting to GRPO with shaped reward OR documenting the ceiling.
